hypothesis: Making the existing output example a valid ten-event chronological day with a residence ending and a weekday worker's required workplace duration may reduce first-response schedule errors without policy-specific behavioral targets.
change_scope: Only the Stage1 example in the v53 common system prompt. Policy rule/background inputs, Stage2 prompt, citizen inputs and model decoding are unchanged.
baseline: Fresh v53 calls on the same frozen 96 contexts and same seed, interleaved with v54 candidate if a GPU window is available. Historical v53 calls alone are a contextual reference, not a new matched control.
primary_technical_gate: Each first raw output is checked without repair against the frozen v3 JSON/time/anchor/category/zone contract; candidate must pass at least 92/96, have zero request failures and zero false fiscal OFF policy-attribution screening flags, and not have more paired raw failures than fresh v53.
secondary_diagnostics: Start/end residence, chronological order and twenty-minute spacing errors separately
More than ten events despite example contract
Stage1 policy-trigger rate shown as a diagnostic, not rewarded for increasing
policy_effect_gate: No Stage2 or transaction effect is measured by this Stage1 screen. A later candidate rollout requires frozen policy inputs and environment, same cohort/date/seed, policy ON/OFF preperiod and accounting gates, and the empirical estimand audit before any direction/size claim.
exclusions: Do not load empirical_registry values into model input. Do not include or rerun P015. Do not change the score contract after seeing responses, add favorable contexts, retry failed raw responses as successes, or stop early.
if_gpu_window_missing: Preserve the frozen unexecuted candidate and report no v54 result; prioritize completed v53 policy numeric report and evidence audit.
